label: Configuration and technical state
examples: device configuration|firmware inventory|cluster manifest|access policy|protection setting|topology export|configuration snapshot

label: Operational and observational
definition: Operation, performance and incidents over a period
examples: telemetry|log|alarm|event|ticket|work order|capacity metric|performance metric|physical observation|inspection record

label: Validation and test
definition: Effectiveness and resilience under stated conditions
examples: commissioning|load test|failover test|recovery test|simulation|scenario exercise|functional test|calibration|witnessed demonstration

label: Independent and third-party
examples: independent engineering review|audit|provider assurance|witnessed test|laboratory result|accredited certificate|regulatory inspection

label: Derived and analytical
examples: trend|correlation|capacity analysis|failure analysis|dependency path|reconciled inventory|score|model output|AI-assisted extraction
